name: week
title: Distribution week
subtitle: Internal working snapshot. Not proof of delivery.

sections.title: Outstanding sheet obligations
sections.sql: select customer,sku,country,language,version,issue from distribution_queue where issue <> 'Current delivery recorded' order by customer,sku

sections.title: Customer requests
sections.sql: select customer,sku,reason,due_on,overdue from request_queue order by due_on

sections.title: Unverified and ageing sheets
sections.sql: select sku,country,version,issued_on,status,issue from review_queue order by issued_on

sections.title: Recorded deliveries
sections.sql: select c.name customer,p.sku,sh.country,sh.version,d.delivered_on,d.evidence,d.actor from deliveries d join sheets sh on sh.id=d.sheet_id join products p on p.id=sh.product_id join subscriptions s on s.id=d.subscription_id join customers c on c.id=s.customer_id order by d.delivered_on desc
